output_expectations.notes: Instance API: var options = new PdfToXlsOptions(); options.Format = PdfToXlsOptions.ExcelFormat.XLSX; options.AddInput(new FileDataSource('input.pdf')); options.AddOutput(new FileDataSource('output.xlsx')); new XlsConverter().Process(options). CRITICAL: PdfConverterOptions is abstract — use PdfToXlsOptions. ExcelFormat is a nested enum: PdfToXlsOptions.ExcelFormat.XLSX (value=1). ExcelFormat values: XMLSpreadSheet2003=0, XLSX=1, CSV=2, XLSM=3, ODS=4. Harness-verified: ResultCollection.Count=1, XLSX magic 50-4B-03-04.
